description: Trace a figure to the filing: for each period, the SEC accession number and form it came from, the filing document, and a sec.gov link that opens that document at the exact line printing the number (built from the record's figure_sources block, matched by exact value and period). A figure with no link was calculated in the record (margins, free cash flow, trailing twelve months, a quarter derived by subtraction) or comes from an earnings release, which the SEC does not tag; the response says which applies. Accepts the same figure names as get_figure.

figure.description: Standard figure name or synonym, a field path, a field name, or words.

period.description: Fiscal period: 'FY2025', 'Q2 FY2027' (also 'FY27Q2', 'Q2 2027'), 'latest', 'latest quarter', 'latest annual', 'ttm', 'ytd', 'annual', 'quarterly', 'all', or a period-end date. The company's own fiscal years. Omit for every period in the latest record. A period earlier than the data held returns that the data does not go back that far, and what is held.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.

name: get_figure_source
title: Where a figure is printed in the SEC filing
